references.text: Psalm 86:15 refers to God's patience and mercy, which reflects the plea for patience in Matthew 18:29.
Matthew 5:7 speaks of the blessing of being merciful, which is relevant to the act of asking for patience and the opportunity to make things right in Matthew 18:29.
Luke 6:36 encourages us to be merciful, just as the Father is merciful, which resonates with the plea for patience in Matthew 18:29.
Hebrews 10:36 speaks of the need for patience to receive God's promises, which can be seen in light of the plea for patience in Matthew 18:29.
